pokemon_scp.name: Victreebel
pokemon_scp.special_containment_procedures: SCP-0071 is to be contained in a hermetically sealed botanical vault with acid‑resistant flooring. Personnel must not approach SCP-0071’s opening without full hazmat protection. All feeding is to be conducted via remote mechanical arms.
pokemon_scp.description: SCP-0071 secretes highly corrosive digestive acid capable of dissolving organic matter within seconds and metal within minutes. Vine appendages allow rapid movement and predatory lunges. SCP-0071 emits pheromones that lure nearby organisms toward its maw.
pokemon_scp.behavior_notes: Aggressive and predatory. Attempts to engulf any moving object within reach.
addendum_logs: Addendum 0071-A: SCP-0071 dissolved a titanium probe in under 40 seconds.
Addendum 0071-B: Pheromone analysis suggests SCP-0071 can mimic scents associated with prey species.

pokemon_scp.name: Tentacool
pokemon_scp.special_containment_procedures: SCP-0072 is to be contained in a toxin‑filtered aquatic chamber. Personnel must avoid contact with SCP-0072’s tentacles.
pokemon_scp.description: SCP-0072 is a jellyfish‑like organism with bioluminescent nodes capable of emitting low‑frequency pulses. Tentacles contain venom that causes disorientation and mild paralysis.
pokemon_scp.behavior_notes: Passive unless threatened. Drifts aimlessly and reacts to vibrations.
addendum_logs: Addendum 0072-A: Venom exposure caused temporary vertigo in a researcher.
Addendum 0072-B: Luminescent pulses disrupted sonar equipment.

pokemon_scp.name: Tentacruel
pokemon_scp.special_containment_procedures: SCP-0073 is to be contained in a deep aquatic vault with toxin scrubbers and reinforced observation windows. Personnel must not enter the water under any circumstances.
pokemon_scp.description: SCP-0073 possesses numerous tentacles capable of delivering powerful neurotoxins. Central node emits pulses that can disrupt electronics and induce panic responses.
pokemon_scp.behavior_notes: Highly aggressive. Uses tentacles to ensnare and crush targets.
addendum_logs: Addendum 0073-A: SCP-0073 shattered a reinforced window with a tentacle strike.
Addendum 0073-B: Neurotoxin samples show rapid adaptation to antidotes.

pokemon_scp.name: Geodude
pokemon_scp.special_containment_procedures: SCP-0074 is to be contained in a rocky enclosure with shock‑absorbent flooring. Personnel may interact with SCP-0074 under supervision.
pokemon_scp.description: SCP-0074 is a rock‑based organism capable of levitation through unknown means. Body composition resembles granite with anomalous density.
pokemon_scp.behavior_notes: Calm and stationary. Occasionally levitates to reposition itself.
addendum_logs: Addendum 0074-A: SCP-0074 levitated for 12 minutes without visible effort.
Addendum 0074-B: Rock samples show crystalline anomalies.

pokemon_scp.name: Graveler
pokemon_scp.special_containment_procedures: SCP-0075 is to be contained in a reinforced geological vault. Personnel must avoid standing near SCP-0075 during rolling behavior.
pokemon_scp.description: SCP-0075 can roll at high speeds, generating shockwaves upon impact. Body mass increases temporarily during rolling events.
pokemon_scp.behavior_notes: Aggressive when disturbed. Uses rolling attacks to defend territory.
addendum_logs: Addendum 0075-A: SCP-0075’s rolling impact fractured a reinforced barrier.
Addendum 0075-B: Mass increase appears to be a temporary density shift.

pokemon_scp.name: Golem
pokemon_scp.special_containment_procedures: SCP-0076 is to be contained in a titan‑grade geological vault with seismic dampeners. Personnel must not enter during agitation cycles.
pokemon_scp.description: SCP-0076 possesses immense physical strength and can generate explosive force by shedding its outer shell. Internal core emits faint radiation.
pokemon_scp.behavior_notes: Aggressive and territorial. Displays strategic awareness of structural weak points.
addendum_logs: Addendum 0076-A: Shell detonation caused structural damage across two containment wings.
Addendum 0076-B: Radiation readings spike during aggression.

pokemon_scp.name: Ponyta
pokemon_scp.special_containment_procedures: SCP-0077 is to be housed in a fire‑resistant equine chamber. Personnel may interact with SCP-0077 under supervision.
pokemon_scp.description: SCP-0077 is an equine organism with a mane composed of controlled flames. Flame temperature varies with emotional state.
pokemon_scp.behavior_notes: Gentle and skittish. Flames intensify when SCP-0077 is excited.
addendum_logs: Addendum 0077-A: SCP-0077’s flames briefly reached 900°C during a panic event.
Addendum 0077-B: Mane samples show anomalous plasma‑like properties.

pokemon_scp.name: Rapidash
pokemon_scp.special_containment_procedures: SCP-0078 is to be contained in a heat‑shielded equine vault with flame‑dampening systems. Personnel must maintain a minimum distance of 20 meters.
pokemon_scp.description: SCP-0078 can run at anomalous speeds exceeding 150 km/h indoors. Flames along its mane and tail can melt reinforced steel.
pokemon_scp.behavior_notes: Aggressive when challenged. Displays territorial dominance.
addendum_logs: Addendum 0078-A: SCP-0078 melted a containment gate during a sprint.
Addendum 0078-B: Flame output increases when SCP-0078 is observed directly.

pokemon_scp.name: Slowpoke
pokemon_scp.special_containment_procedures: SCP-0079 is to be contained in a shallow aquatic chamber with mild psychic dampeners. Personnel may interact with SCP-0079 under supervision.
pokemon_scp.description: SCP-0079 exhibits delayed reaction times and mild psychic emissions. Tail secretes a sweet substance with mild narcotic effects.
pokemon_scp.behavior_notes: Docile and slow-moving. Shows little awareness of surroundings.
addendum_logs: Addendum 0079-A: Tail secretion caused mild euphoria in exposed personnel.
Addendum 0079-B: Psychic emissions correlate with SCP-0079’s emotional state.

pokemon_scp.name: Slowbro
pokemon_scp.special_containment_procedures: SCP-0080 is to be contained in a mid‑depth aquatic chamber with psychic dampeners. Personnel must avoid proximity to SCP-0080’s tail.
pokemon_scp.description: SCP-0080’s tail is fused with a parasitic organism that enhances its psychic abilities. Displays increased awareness and defensive aggression.
pokemon_scp.behavior_notes: Calm but protective. Parasitic organism reacts independently to threats.
addendum_logs: Addendum 0080-A: Parasitic organism attempted to bite a containment drone.
Addendum 0080-B: Psychic output spikes when SCP-0080 is startled.
